newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends easier on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends easier on dollar demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed easier at 42.5375/42.5475 to the dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous 42.5375/42.5450, dealers said.
The taka quoted at 42.5335/42.5450 against dollar in early trading.
Dealers said the taka, which opened mostly steady, slipped slightly on demands for dollars from state-owned banks seeking import payments.
The interbank call money rates closed up at 5.0 percent to 5.5 percent against the previous 4.5-5.0 percent.
